diff.before: The public declaration is the actual uncentered squared-moment producer. The separate private Tests consumer now implements centered and cosine-weighted square integrability and both true operator-norm comparisons in the same original experiment. Its extended independent source/native/reader acceptance is pending, and the full R9 SAU remains EXPLORING. Public API placement, matrix concentration, main lower bounds, exact oracle/precision/TV/query-cap/cost adapters, serialized integration/publication and purification remain open.
diff.after: The public declaration proves the actual uncentered squared-moment comparison. The separate private Tests consumer proves centered and cosine-weighted square integrability and both true operator-norm comparisons in the same original experiment. Only the uncentered declaration is a public API; the centered and weighted theorem is a private implementation consumer. Verification and publication evidence is recorded separately in the existing Frontier Cell and semantic audit. Public API canonicalization, matrix concentration, main lower bounds, exact oracle/precision/TV/query-cap/cost adapters and serialized integration/purification are distinct later obligations.
